newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up, seen at high levels.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up, seen at high levels.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates closed higher on Saturday amid shortage of liquidity and dealers said rates were likely to stay high in the absence of any major inflows.
"The market opened with tight liquidity and early overnights were seen at around 19.90 percent," one dealer said. The closing deals were seen at 19.95 and 20 percent levels, he added.
The dealer said rates may remain on the higher side as no major inflows or maturities were expected.
